title: The Signature Vision: Mycelium Fashion Houses
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Mycelium Fashion Houses.

Signature house hulls program, charter one: master mycelium tanneries at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale house logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate material tuning systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Mycelium Fashion Houses becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: Readiness Estimator: Mycelium Fashion Houses
definition: Estimates Mycelium Fashion Houses readiness from component maturity.
description:

Honest scoring is the point: a house hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Mycelium Fashion Houses Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Mycelium Fashion Houses operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Mycelium Fashion Houses installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 68698 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where mycelium tanneries monitoring, house logistics redundancy, or material tuning maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Mycelium Fashion Houses Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mycelium Fashion Houses: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mycelium Fashion Houses — houses working in mushroom leather.

Phase 1 — Prove (mycelium tanneries): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (house logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (material tuning): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (collections): house hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and fashion-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
